description_for_human: Frame, run, inspect, and propose governed decisions on the customer-hosted Algenta gateway.
description_for_model: Coarse decision operations. Prefer run_decision_analysis (it internally runs scenarios, simulation, optimization, sensitivity and produces a recommendation). Approval and execution are intentionally NOT exposed here — they are separate credentialed human actions.

functions.name: create_or_update_decision
functions.description: Frame a decision (create a case + immutable revision) or re-frame an existing case.

functions.name: run_decision_analysis
functions.description: Run the governed analysis for a case: evidence -> scenarios -> simulate -> optimize -> sensitivity -> recommendation. Async (202 + poll).

functions.name: get_decision_result
functions.description: Fetch the host-independent result object for an analysis run.

functions.name: inspect_decision_evidence
functions.description: Return the evidence + provenance for a run (what was accessed, under which retention mode).

functions.name: propose_action_plan
functions.description: Propose a safe execution plan for a completed run; returns a plan hash for a later human approval.
